name: ifdown_remediate
description: Remediation playbook when a LogOS surface is down (ifdown). Returns ordered steps: kill stale ports, restart registry/manifold/forge bridge, re-run gauge_verify(7,8), and record ATOM decision. Does not auto-promote; capability ≠ authority.

surface.description: registry | forge_ws | manifold | mcp | tui | all

dry_run.description: If true (default), return steps without executing host commands
